metadata.description: Agent skills for data engineering: designing analytics data platforms, and building the pipelines that feed them.

plugins.name: data-engineering
plugins.description: Designs and reviews analytics data platforms (tier and tool choice, ingestion method, serving, sensitive-data decisions, erasure design) and builds their pipelines in the repo: dead letters and version-guarded redrive, tombstones, CDC traps, reruns and backfill, keyed pseudonyms, erasure jobs, and cheap checks after every load.
